_comment: Swipe direction to configuration slot, replayed by the macOS geometry (modules/gestures/geometry.lua) and the Linux evdev decoder (modules/gestures/mt_decoder.lua). Angles use the screen convention both drivers classify in: 0 is right and 90 is down, so y grows downward. Units differ per driver, so each consumer scales the unit vector to a multiple of its own swipe threshold: travel 'swipe' is four times the threshold, travel 'short' a quarter of it, which is no swipe at all (slot null). Both drivers put the axis/diagonal boundary near 25 degrees (macOS at 25 and 65, Linux at a 2:1 axis ratio, about 26.6), so the boundary vectors sit at 15, 35, 55 and 75 degrees, inside the same region on both. A slot is swipe_<fingers>_<direction>, horizontal part first for a diagonal, and must be declared in _shared/modules/actions/actions.toml.
